Lemma
[Hölder's inequality] ↗ lem:youngs-inequality 1. appB:B.2-e\group Elementary Inequalities

Let $1\leq p,q\leq \infty $ satisfy $p^{-1}+q^{-1}=1$. If $u\in L^p(U)$ and $v\in L^q(U)$, then \[ (8)\qquad \int _U|uv|\, dx \leq \| u\| _{L^p(U)}\| v\| _{L^q(U)}. \]
Proof

\sketch For $1<p,q<\infty $, homogeneity reduces to $\| u\| _{L^p}=\| v\| _{L^q}=1$. Apply (6) pointwise to $|u|$ and $|v|$ and integrate. The cases $(p,q)=(1,\infty )$ and $(\infty ,1)$ follow directly from the essential-supremum definition.

□
